impact.security: JWT current reciprocal couple, owner writes, field-level privacy, shared-meal explicit opt-in
impact.data: New nutrition profiles/day records/food snapshots/shared portions/templates

impact.realtime: nutritionSync invalidation only after persistence; no private values in event

risk.rollback: Revert application release; leave new nutrition collections intact, no destructive migration.
